answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable deposit before joining the market, like an opal set in a ring: the stake is visible and costly to duplicate. New identities must also earn reputation slowly through an inlet of verified, low-value trades before accessing large deals, and their history is published on a shared knoll of public records. A Sybil attacker must fund thousands of deposits and patiently build each fake history, so forging an army costs far more than any single fraud can repay.
